annotations.title: China Border Narcotic & Psychotropic Prescription Compliance Screener

description: Screen personal prescription drugs and over-the-counter remedies by English brand, generic ingredient, or Chinese alias against China Customs Class I/II psychotropic controls, carrying-day caps, and Red Channel paperwork checklists.

categoryFilter.description: Optional control category filter to narrow matches (all, psychotropic_1, psychotropic_2, narcotic, prescription, otc_allowed).

medicationQuery.description: Generic ingredient, US/EU brand name, or Chinese medicine name (e.g. "Adderall", "Zolpidem", "Ritalin", "ibuprofen").
